title: Jessica-Beth’s single “Cuts Deep” takes us on a dive into heartache
htmlContent:
Some songs hit you hard, while others provide comfort and then there are songs like Jessica-Beth's "Cuts Deep" that do both beautifully. This artist, who began her journey in opera and has transitioned to contemporary music, has created a stunning pop ballad that is as heartfelt as it is well-crafted.

"Cuts Deep" feels like a personal story shared in a moment of vulnerability. Jessica-Beth's voice is rich and emotional, weaving through the gentle piano backdrop in a way that allows the feelings of pain and beauty to exist side by side. Her delivery has a dramatic flair, reflecting her training in opera. It balances being controlled and open, drawing listeners into its emotional depths.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4SELyAreNQ3Hf2fbQ5LkjM?si=GdQFBlOGQKybCg6-0uKayA

"Cuts Deep" dives deep into the raw reality of emotional hurt that doesn't fade away. Jessica-Beth embodies her music, making every word resonate with authenticity. If you enjoy songs that tell heartfelt stories and artists who express their emotions openly, keep an eye on Jessica-Beth. "Cuts Deep" is a song that stays with you once it touches your heart.
